per_case_results.question: Find all cards illustrated by Stephen Daniel and describe the text of the ruling of these cards. State if these cards have missing or degraded properties and values.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.id, T2.text, T1.hasContentWarning FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    c."name",
    c."text",
    CASE 
        WHEN c."text" IS NULL OR c."text" = '' THEN 'Missing Text'
        WHEN LENGTH(c."text") < 10 THEN 'Degraded Text'
        ELSE 'Complete'
    END AS "text_status"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" = 'Stephen Daniel'
LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: Name the card and artist with the most ruling information. Also state if the card is a promotional printing.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.name, T1.artist, T1.isPromo FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isPromo = 1 AND T1.artist = (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) = (SELECT MAX(count_uuid) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS count_uuid FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist) AS subquery)) LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    "cards"."name",
    "cards"."artist",
    "cards"."ispromo"
FROM 
    "cards"
WHERE 
    "cards"."id" = (
        SELECT 
            "id"
        FROM 
            "cards"
        WHERE 
            "cards"."text" IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY 
            LENGTH("cards"."text") DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
LIMIT 1
